hypotheses.C0_pairwise_route_recovers_canonical_sub: On failures, median rank-16 projector overlap is >=0.95 and the minimum is >=0.80.
hypotheses.C1_canonical_subspace_recovers_finite_ef: On failures, exact- versus reconstructed-subspace removal has median finite Fisher fidelity >=0.95 and 10th percentile >=0.80.
hypotheses.C2_leading_direction_is_stable_when_iden: Among failures whose exact top eigengap is >=1.1, aligned leading directions have median absolute cosine >=0.95 and finite-effect fidelity >=0.90.
hypotheses.C3_sparse_failures_are_extractor_specifi: Failure cases have median sparse infinitesimal fidelity <0.8 but median canonical-subspace finite fidelity >=0.95; controls pass both at >=0.95.
